name: Leveling Up

tiers.achievements: At level 2, you gain a new {{term:experience|Experience}} at +2 and permanently increase your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}} by 1.
At level 5, you gain a new {{term:experience|Experience}} at +2, permanently increase your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}} by 1, and clear any marked traits.
At level 8, you gain a new {{term:experience|Experience}} at +2, permanently increase your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}} by 1, and clear any marked traits.

advancements.text: _When you choose to_ **_increase two unmarked character_** **_traits_** _and mark them:_ Choose two unmarked character traits and gain a permanent +1 bonus to them. You can’t increase these stats again until the next {{term:tier|tier}} (when your {{term:tier|tier}} achievement allows you to clear those marks).

_When you choose to_ **_permanently add 1 or more {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}_** **_slots_**_:_ Darken the outline of the next rectangle in the {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}} section of your character sheet in pen or permanent marker.

_When you choose to_ **_permanently add 1 or more {{term:stress|Stress}}_** **_slots_**_:_ Darken the outline of the next rectangle in the {{term:stress|Stress}} section of your character sheet in pen or permanent marker.
_When you choose to_ **_increase your {{term:experience|Experience}}_**_:_ Choose two {{term:experience|Experiences}} on your character sheet and gain a permanent +1 bonus to both.

_When you_ **_take an additional {{term:domain-card|domain card}}_**_:_ You can choose an additional {{term:domain-card|domain card}} at or below your level or from your class’s domains. If you’ve {{term:multiclass|multiclassed}}, you can instead select a card at or below half your level from your chosen {{term:multiclass|multiclass}} domain.
_When you choose to_ **_increase your {{term:evasion|Evasion}}_**_:_ Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your {{term:evasion|Evasion}}.

_When you choose to_ **_take an upgraded subclass card_**_:_ Take the next card for your subclass. If you have only the foundation card, take a specialization; if you have a specialization already, take a mastery. Then cross out this {{term:tier|tier}}’s {{term:multiclass|multiclass}} option.

_When you choose to_ **_increase your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}}_**_:_ Fill in one of the open circles in the “{{term:proficiency|Proficiency}}” section of your character sheet, then increase your weapon’s number of damage dice by 1. _The black box around this advancement’s_ _slots indicates you must spend two advancements and mark_ _both level-up slots in order to take it as an option._

_When you choose to_ **_{{term:multiclass|multiclass}}_**_:_ Choose an additional class, select one of its domains, and gain its class feature. Add the appropriate **{{term:multiclass|multiclass}} module** to your character sheet and take the foundation card from one of its subclasses. Then cross out the “upgraded subclass” advancement option in this {{term:tier|tier}} and all other “{{term:multiclass|multiclass}}” advancement options on your character sheet. _The black box around_ _this advancement’s slots indicates you must spend two_ _advancements and mark both level-up slots in order to take_ _it as an option._

companionOptions.name: Intelligent
companionOptions.text: Your companion gains a permanent +1 bonus to a Companion {{term:experience|Experience}} of your choice.

companionOptions.name: Light in the Dark
companionOptions.text: Use this as an additional {{term:hope|Hope}} slot your character can mark.

companionOptions.name: Creature Comfort
companionOptions.text: Once per rest, when you take time during a quiet moment to give your companion love and attention, you can gain a {{term:hope|Hope}} or you can both clear a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

companionOptions.name: Armored
companionOptions.text: When your companion takes damage, you can **mark one of your {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slots}}** instead of marking one of their {{term:stress|Stress}}.

companionOptions.name: Vicious
companionOptions.text: Increase your companion’s damage dice or range by one step (d6 to d8, Close to Far, etc.).

companionOptions.name: Resilient
companionOptions.text: Your companion gains an additional {{term:stress|Stress}} slot.

companionOptions.name: Bonded
companionOptions.text: When you mark your last {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}, your companion rushes to your side to comfort you. Roll a number of **d6s** equal to the unmarked {{term:stress|Stress}} slots they have and mark them. If any roll a 6, your companion helps you up. Clear your last {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}} and return to the scene.

companionOptions.name: Aware
companionOptions.text: Your companion gains a permanent +2 bonus to their {{term:evasion|Evasion}}.

text:
Your party levels up whenever the GM decides you’ve reached a narrative milestone (usually about every 3 sessions). All party members level up at the same time.

Daggerheart has 10 PC levels divided into 4 tiers:

→ Tier 1 encompasses level 1 only.

→ Tier 2 encompasses levels 2–4.

→ Tier 3 encompasses levels 5–7.

→ Tier 4 encompasses levels 8–10.

Your {{term:tier|tier}} affects your {{term:damage-thresholds|damage thresholds}}, {{term:tier|tier}} achievements, and access to advancements.
